affectedCopies: BacklogItem.outcome / BacklogItem.outcomeSource, written by ingestBacklogItem (apps/web/lib/operate/backlog-ingest.ts), createBacklogItem / updateBacklogItem (apps/web/lib/actions/backlog.ts), update_backlog_item (apps/web/lib/mcp/packs/backlog-update-item-handler.ts) and the hourly ops/backlog-outcome-reconcile job (apps/web/lib/backlog/outcome-backfill.ts); read by get_backlog_item, the Workroom projection (apps/web/lib/work-management/room-item-outcome.ts) and the claim path (apps/web/lib/work-capsules/work-capsule-store.ts)
ProductOutcomeObservation.backlogItemId, written by recordDeliveredWorkOutcome and recordItemOutcomeEvents (apps/web/lib/product-management/delivered-work-outcomes-repository.ts)
The legacy body '## Outcome' section on older items is input only: the reconcile job lifts it into the field as stated and never edits the body

privacyAssessment.sensitivity: internal: the outcome sentence of a work item, at the same sensitivity as the item's title and body
privacyAssessment.dataSubjectRights: Not applicable; the outcome describes work, not a person. It follows the item's existing sensitivity classification.
privacyAssessment.reviewDisposition: A short statement already present in, or derived from, the item's own title and body. No new personal content.

migration.name: 20261028210000_backlog_item_outcome
migration.backfill: Not in the migration. Every existing row gets NULL in both columns, which the CHECK allows. The hourly ops/backlog-outcome-reconcile job fills open items (triaging, open, in-progress, awaiting-acceptance, blocked, deferred) at most 250 per run through resolveItemOutcome, with a compare-and-set on outcome IS NULL, preserving updatedAt. Live install at 2026-10-28: about 3,557 open items. Observation backlogItemId stays NULL on the 1 existing row (OBS-34E301FBC558).
migration.rollback: Forward-only and additive. Older code neither reads nor writes the columns; rolling the code back leaves the outcomes in place unread.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing model; the columns follow the item row and its lifecycle.

fields.reason: The outcome the item delivers: what will be true, and for whom, once it is done. One home for it (WWMD DI-342D45001EF5).
Who wrote the outcome: stated (a person or agent) or derived (the platform drafted it from the item's context; visible and correctable). Closed set enforced by BacklogItem_outcomeSource_closed_set.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Existing model; the link is SET NULL if the item row is ever removed, so the observation is kept.

fields.reason: The backlog item whose own outcome this observation measures (WWMD DI-19ED69C312FC); null for a business Product measure. Indexed.
